summary: Sends a multiplayer join request to the host. Looks up the session entry at index a2 from the entry array at obj+0x1B79C (offset 112540) via IndexBoundsCheckedArrayRead and returns 0 when it is missing. Formats a host:port string into a local buffer (IPAddressToString after StringComparisonWithConstantDispatch, then StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck with the aHostport format literal). Debug-logs 'sending join request' through DebugLogWrite when the session-type global dword_7C569C is not 5 and the dev string check passes, resets the join flag at obj+0x378 (offset 888) to 0, and delegates the send to CollisionSpatialQuery. Invoked by MultiplayerPasswordValidation (0x0046DD30).

local_names.this: network session manager object (primary pointer at this+0x0)
local_names.a2: session/game index used to select the host session entry
local_names.v4: session entry pointer returned by the bounds-checked read
local_names.v6: IP address string produced by IPAddressToString
local_names.v8: port number used in the '%s:%d' format
local_names.v10: trailing port field of the format buffer
local_names.v11: trailing terminator byte of the format buffer

operations.description: Bounds-checked read of the session entry at index a2 from the entry array stored at obj+0x1B79C (offset 112540 in raw source), where obj is the object behind the primary pointer at this+0x0
If the session entry lookup returns null, the function returns 0 without sending
Initializes the host:port buffer: copies byte_5EA438[0], zero-fills the rest with memset, and clears the trailing port/terminator fields
StringComparisonWithConstantDispatch(0) selects the string-conversion mode used by the address formatting
IPAddressToString converts the session entry to an address string
StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck formats the host:port '%s:%d' string into the local buffer using the address string and port; the format literal is the packet global aHostport
Debug logging is gated on the session-type global dword_7C569C being different from 5
StringSplitLoop(1, aDDevF119992002_1, 6657) performs the dev-build string check; when it succeeds, DebugLogWrite logs the aSendingJoinReq message through the dword_8AD25C buffer
Resets the join flag at obj+0x378 (offset 888 in raw source) to 0 before sending
Delegates the actual send to CollisionSpatialQuery(host:port string, a3) and returns its result
Invoked by MultiplayerPasswordValidation (0x0046DD30) after the password validation path
